summary: Stockfish 19 is an open‑source, highly‑optimized chess engine delivered as a CLI executable, C++ library, and WebAssembly module. It builds on decades of engine development and leverages NNUE techniques, running locally without any API keys. The engine is suited for chess programmers and researchers needing a strong, self‑hosted opponent or evaluation tool. It stands out with massive community adoption (16,562 stars) and mature code, though its test suite shows limited functionality coverage.
